titleAr: اعمل أكواد استرجاع جديدة للتحقق بخطوتين

undo.note: the old set is invalidated at once; the new codes are shown once

ar: خلّصت أكواد التحقق الاحتياطية، اعمل ايه؟
en: How do I get new recovery codes?

steps: Enter password and a current authenticator code (served by the accounts service: GET /mfa/recovery-codes, POST /mfa/recovery-codes/regenerate)
Press Make new recovery codes and save the codes shown
edgeCases: Needs password AND a live authenticator code; a recovery code is refused as the step-up
Regenerating retires every old code in one statement
Lost authenticator and codes: staff reset via scripts/mfa-reset.ts (last resort, docs/runbooks/mfa-recovery.md)
